intro: Guatemala is Central America's largest economy, exporting coffee, bananas, cardamom and sugar.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Guatemala is the world's top exporter of cardamom. Money sent home from Guatemalans in the US is a large part of the economy.

chapters.title: Coffee
text: Highland coffee from Antigua and Huehuetenango is prized.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Guatemala makes and sells to the world.
